issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 100.48 (Sinking Fund column, p4)
issues.issue: Worksheet p4 puts this receipt in the Sinking Fund, whose only asset is Investments 6,876.04, and the Sinking Fund balance forward is 6,976.52 (exactly +100.48). That points to investment earnings, so investment income would fit. The amount is small (0.8% of receipts), so leaving it in other with review is defensible.
